info.title: Herald Server
info.description: Herald DemoApp — installable global tool that runs Herald Server with the embedded Dashboard SPA. Install with `dotnet tool install --global Herald.DemoApp` and run `herald-demo` to see the Dashboard SPA and a live Herald pipeline in your browser.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Standalone API server for the Herald logging framework.

options.name: --log-dir
options.description: Directory for log files and sample data (default: logs)

options.name: --api-key
options.description: Enable API key auth on /api/* endpoints (off by default)

options.name: --cors-allow-any
options.description:
Permissive CORS (AllowAnyOrigin). Unsafe if
you ever add AllowCredentials; avoid in prod.

options.name: --tenant
options.description:
Boot-time tenant id for operator pipelines.
Defaults to 'default'. Non-default values
require the Enterprise edition. Also reads
HERALD_TENANT env var.

options.name: --node-id
options.description:
Stable node id for multi-replica deployments.
Also reads HERALD_NODE_ID env var.

options.name: --tls-cert
options.description: PEM cert for direct HTTPS (Pro edition).

options.name: --tls-key
options.description: <path>     PEM key for direct HTTPS (Pro edition).

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help message
Authentication:
Off by default. Solo devs and local setups don't need it.
Enable with --api-key when the server is shared or exposed.
Clients send the key as:
Authorization: Bearer <key>
X-Api-Key: <key>
/health is always open (no auth required).
Note: Debug vs Release is determined at build time, not by a runtime flag.
Use 'dotnet run -c Debug' to build and run in Debug mode.
Simulation is controlled from the Herald Dashboard UI.
API Endpoints (mapped by SDK/HeraldEndpointMapper):
GET  /health                    Health check (version, build, uptime)
GET  /api/config                Current JSON configuration
GET  /api/inspection            Builder inspection snapshot
GET  /api/validation            Validation result
GET  /api/diagnostics           Pipeline diagnostic dump
GET  /api/pipeline/state        Runtime state + version + simulation flag
GET  /api/pipeline/components   Registered component types
GET  /api/levels                All registered log levels
GET  /api/levelStyles           Level display styles
GET  /api/logs/recent           Recent captured log entries
GET  /api/logs/stream           Live log stream (SSE, batched)
GET  /api/diagnosticMode        Simulation state
PUT  /api/diagnosticMode        Toggle simulation
PUT  /api/config/minimumLevel   Set minimum log level
PUT  /api/config/strategy       Set pipeline strategy
POST /api/config/apply          Apply full JSON configuration
POST /api/config/reset          Reset to defaults
